story_type: dismasted sailboat far offshore, locator beacon, basket hoist
hook: Thanksgiving Day, 170 miles out to sea, his mast broke.
narration: Thanksgiving Day, a hundred and seventy miles out to sea, and his sailboat's main mast broke.
With the boat disabled, he activated his personal locator beacon.
A beacon like that sends a distress signal and his position up to satellites, and from there to rescuers on shore.
A Coast Guard Jayhawk came in low over the sailboat and lowered its rescue basket on the cable.
At the door, the flight mechanic hauled the basket in with the sailor still sitting inside.
outcome: The Coast Guard aircrew hoisted him off his disabled sailboat, a hundred and seventy miles from Pamlico Sound.

location_card.place: 170 miles east of Pamlico Sound, N.C.

title: Mast broke 170 miles out at sea
description:
On Nov. 28, 2019, a Coast Guard helicopter crew hoisted a man from his disabled sailboat 170 miles east of Pamlico Sound, North Carolina. He had activated a personal locator beacon after the boat's main mast broke.
